Package be.stef.rar4.decompress

Class Rar4BitDecoder

java.lang.Object
be.stef.rar4.decompress.Rar4BitDecoder
public class Rar4BitDecoder extends Object
Sequential bit reader for RAR4 compressed streams.

RAR4 uses MSB-first (big-endian) bit ordering. The reader maintains an internal byte buffer and exposes 16-bit and 32-bit windows into the current bit position for Huffman and raw-bit decoding.

The buffer is refilled transparently when the read position approaches the end of valid data.

    • refill

      public boolean refill() throws IOException
      Shifts unprocessed bytes to the front of the buffer and reads more data from the underlying stream to fill the remaining capacity.
      Returns:

      public boolean shouldRefill()

    • peek16

      public int peek16()
      Returns a 16-bit window starting at the current bit position, without advancing the position. The window is aligned to MSB-first ordering.

      Equivalent to WinRAR's getbits() internal function.

    • peek32

      public long peek32()
      Returns a 32-bit window starting at the current bit position, without advancing the position.

      Equivalent to WinRAR's fgetbits() internal function.

    • skip

      public void skip(int n)
      Advances the read position by n bits.
      Parameters:
      n - number of bits to skip (must be >= 0)

    • readBits

      public int readBits(int n)
      Reads n bits MSB-first and advances the position.
      Parameters:
      n - number of bits to read (1-16)
      Returns:
      the bit value

    • alignToByte

      public void alignToByte()
      Aligns the read position to the next byte boundary. Any remaining bits in the current byte are discarded.
